{{Quote|Well hello there. Have you come to watch me dance? I'm quite adept.''"<br />"''I would love to see you dance!|Allura and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TfaB" />}}
'''Allura''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[entertainer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and used to perform in [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun's]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Cantina]].<ref name="SWG:TfaB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Allura encountered a spacer in the cantina who was recommended and sent by one of her friend by the name [[Trehla Keelo]]. The spacer had just landed on Tatooine and was looking for work. Allura therefore agreed with teaching some of her dance moves.<ref name="SWG:TfaB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Allura was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TfaB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Allura was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> She was part of an introductory questline intended to help new players who spawned on Tatooine right after the completion of the "New Player Tutorial" to chose their "[[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]]."<ref name="SWG:TfaB" /> Allura's quest was removed from the game upon the overhaul of the "[[W:c:swg:Professions|profession]]" system with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], 2005.<ref name="SWG:2005" />
